ourJourney.title: OUR JOURNEY
ourJourney.subtitle: Together
ourJourney.text: Building our life together has been our favorite adventure yet. As we look back on our journey, we realize how incredibly lucky we are to have such wonderful friends and family supporting us from all over. When it came time to plan our wedding, we knew we wanted to bring everyone together in a place that holds a special piece of our hearts. We are absolutely thrilled to invite you to El Salvador next summer. Celebrating our marriage at Forêt, surrounded by lush natural beauty and all of our favorite people, is a dream come true for both of us.

honeymoon.description: If you must insist on gifting us something other than your presence, you're in the right place! Here you can find a list of things we are planning to do for our amazing honeymoon! You can choose different experiences for us, and pay for a part of our first adventure as a family.

logistics.title: TRAVEL AND LOGISTICS
logistics.q1: WHAT AIRPORT SHOULD I FLY INTO?
logistics.a1: You will want to book your flights into El Salvador International Airport (SAL). It is the primary international hub and is located approximately 1 hour from San Salvador and 1.5 hours from Comasagua.
logistics.a2: You're one of our most valued guests, and we thank you for checking so early. We are working with a travel agency to secure special rates on a direct flight from Toronto to San Salvador on Friday August 6 and from El Salvador to Toronto on Monday August 8. Please enter your e-mail through our RSVP page and we'll send you a message when these rates have been confirmed. If you chose to book your flight independently, proceed with your planning!
logistics.q3: DO I NEED A TRAVEL VISA TO ENTER EL SALVADOR?
logistics.a3: Most visitors, including Canadian and American citizens, do not need a visa for short visits. You will need a passport valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates and a $12 USD tourist card, which is typically purchased upon arrival at the airport.
logistics.q4: WHAT IF I WANT TO STAY FOR LONGER?
logistics.a4: If you would like to stay and vacation in El Salvador, the week after the wedding is recommended, as the week prior is a Salvadoran holiday week and tourist attractions tend to become overwhelmed with visitors. Click here to see tours available to our guests along with the prices per person.
logistics.q5: SHOULD I RENT A CAR, OR IS IT BETTER TO USE UBERS AND TAXIS?
logistics.a5: If you are only staying for the weekend of celebration, we recommend using Uber. San Salvador is an Uber friendly city, where transport is cheap and reliable. For tours and transportation to other parts of the country, we recommend booking with private tour providers as they handle all transport needs related to our events.

accommodations.title: ACCOMMODATIONS
accommodations.a: We have arranged a special group rate for our wedding guests for the nights of August 6, 7, and 8, 2027, at the Sheraton Presidente San Salvador Hotel. We recommend booking early using our exclusive reservation link to guarantee availability and the negotiated group rate.
accommodations.linkNote: Official direct Marriott reservation link for the Shields-Urquilla wedding group

details.title: DETAILS FOR AUGUST 7
details.q1: WHEN AND WHERE IS THE WEDDING TAKING PLACE?
details.a1: The ceremony and reception will both be held on Saturday, August 7, 2027, at Forêt in Comasagua, El Salvador. Starting at 3:30 pm.
details.q2: HOW DO I GET TO THE VENUE?
details.a2: We will provide shuttles between the Sheraton Presidente Hotel and the venue on the day of the wedding! You just need to be ready at the lobby of the hotel by 2:30 pm on Saturday August 7 2027. If you prefer to drive, you should set your GPS to Forêt (Desvío El Limón, Calle a Comasagua, Santa Tecla 1506, El Salvador) Valet Parking will be provided on site throughout the evening.
details.a3: This event requires formal attire. For Women: Floor-length gowns or elegant ankle-grazing dresses. We encourage the use of colorful outfits that show your personality! Keep in mind that Forêt is located in the mountains, so the venue features uneven natural terrain, and evenings can get a bit breezy. Block heels, platforms, or flats are highly recommended, along with a small cover or light jacket. For Men: A well-tailored suit. Feel free to explore elegant colors such as tan, brown, or go with a classic charcoal, black, or gray suit paired with a crisp light dress shirt and a necktie or bow tie. A tuxedo is entirely appropriate but not strictly required. Dress shoes are a must.
details.dressCodeNoteText: We prohibit the use of dresses or suits that are white or mostly white. Any person wearing inappropriate attire will be kindly asked to change.

faqs.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know for our wedding day

whoIsTuty.a: Tuty has been a widely accepted nickname for Camila, and many of you might know them as Tuty exclusively! Please feel free to use Tuty, Camila, or Sofía, to refer to the bride, whichever you would prefer!

dietary.q: WHAT IF I HAVE DIETARY RESTRICTIONS?
dietary.a: Please complete your RSVP normally and indicate any allergies or dietary restrictions in it so our chef can make sure your food is safe and yummy!

kids.a: Children mentioned in your invitation are welcome at our wedding ceremony entrance; however, our reception is designed with adult guests in mind. In order to provide parents freedom to celebrate and peace of mind, children under the age of 13 will be asked to relocate to an on-site kid's tent equipped with entertainment, quiet corner, and fully bilingual nannies, once the ceremony entrance is over and everyone is seated. If your child is 13 years old or older, the option to accompany the parents during the ceremony and reception will be available. Parents are welcome to check on their children at any point. Children under the age of 4 will be provided with a one-on-one nanny.

kidsFood.a: There will be a kid's friendly buffet of fruits, veggies, and kid's favorites (pizza, chicken fingers, mac and cheese) available to all kids through the evening, as well as fresh water, soft drinks, and juice. Wedding cake will be brought to the kids by staff. Please state any allergies in your RSVP.

ceremonyPhotos.q: CAN I TAKE PICTURES DURING THE CEREMONY?
ceremonyPhotos.a: Because of the spiritual nature of our ceremony, and to avoid interfering with our hired professional photographers, please refrain from taking any pictures during and right after the ceremony. This includes cellphones or any other personal camera devices. Your attention is of utmost importance to us!

receptionPhotos.q: CAN I TAKE PICTURES DURING THE RECEPTION?
receptionPhotos.a: Absolutely! Please feel free to use your phone normally after the ceremony. We only ask that you refrain from interfering with the photographers on site. Be mindful of your position in the room and please avoid blocking the view of any cameras during important moments such as speeches, first dance, and cake cutting.

rsvpDeadline.a: Please kindly RSVP by June 7 so we can finalize our final guest count and details. You can RSVP directly through this website on the RSVP tab. Any person who doesn't complete the RSVP prior to the deadline will be marked as 'not attending' and will not be permitted seating during our event; so make sure you reserve your spot and plate with time!

djSongs.q: CAN I ASK THE DJ FOR A SONG?
djSongs.a: Please refrain from approaching the DJ or music band to request songs during the event. If you have any song requests, we kindly ask you to include them in your RSVP or playlist.
